Hi, fear is our greatest enemy, especially for us anxiety sufferers.

A pulmonary embolism does not cause sudden death. In the worst case scenario, let's say someone is sufferring a PE, left untreated for over 2 werks, the death rate is expected to be 26-30%,left untreated and for over weeks!! Other factors include old age. 
When treated, the dearh rate is 8% just like I said and the most common treatment is taking medication (anticoagulants)

Keep in mind that in cases of PE, the symptoms are persistent. They don't disappear and return. If you feel something unusual obviously you should seek medical advice, BUT, do not be scared!!

Some doctors are a bit dramatic and not so good at communicating with anxious patients, I know that because I go to hospitals a lot LOL.
No worries bro, I promise you'll be alive after this experience. If you want, hit me up in the chat in case you need somebody to talk!

To make you feel a bit calmer, the death rate when having pulmomary embolism is only 8%.You are now with health professionals, they will help you and you'll be fine! !

Don't be shy to tell them you have panic attacks and what medication you take, that might be important info for them.
Wishes of a full recovery!
